headline: Chinese AI companies including DeepSeek and Xiaomi released 16 models last month, Nikkei Asia reports, even though Anthropic's chief executive has urged the industry to slow down.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: only the opening paragraph was readable, so the count and context are unverified.
importance_line: The report suggests Chinese labs are not slowing down in response to safety warnings, but the count of 16 models is Nikkei's and has not been confirmed by other outlets.
summary: Nikkei Asia reports that DeepSeek, Xiaomi and other Chinese AI developers released 16 models last month, despite calls from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to slow down as risks grow. Nikkei says Beijing's AI push shows no sign of easing.
notes: Paywalled; opening paragraph only; no other outlet found.
